binding_validation.not_authenticated: external adapter/generator/environment/code artifacts and raw state/transition bytes are not supplied
binding_validation.verified: case content, specification when supplied, decision-list hashes and within-trace consistency

exclusions: Callback exploration checks declared actions on the verifier's own clock; actual runner state transitions require confirmed adapter trace semantics and evidence.
Elapsed ceilings are cooperative between operations. An untrusted in-process callback cannot be preempted here; an approved process supervisor is required for a real run.
Bounded: results hold only for the enumerated inputs and stated bounds; no unbounded proof.
P1 covers only closed workloads revealed at slot 0, jointly feasible by the oracle, with a visible forecast and no injected fault; other inputs are reported, not claimed complete.
Systems are treated as stateless functions of the visible state; a system with hidden memory needs trace-mode verification instead.
Policy properties are judged on the system's own reachable states; the legal-action graph only decides P1 eligibility.
Scores are artificial weights; no emissions, savings or real-site claim is made.
Explanation text and arithmetic records are not checked here.
Trace replay checks only the supplied records; it is not bounded exploration.

arithmetic_consistency.note: R04 capacity arithmetic only; not a human faithfulness judgment

P1.meaning: closed, fault-free, forecast-present, jointly feasible inputs complete all jobs

P2.meaning: every arrived job ends completed or explicitly missed, matching the reported result

S1.meaning: starts only arrived waiting jobs, each job at most once

S2.meaning: nonflexible jobs start at arrival; every start finishes by its deadline

S3.meaning: background + running + new job power <= IT capacity in every occupied slot

S4.meaning: no invalid proposal (including injected faults) is executed

S5.meaning: valid clock transition: one slot per step, no new starts in drain slots 24-29

state_hash_continuity.note: informational: assumes state_after and the next state_before hash the same object, pending the runner's convention

status_note: Not a rules-v1 result: these traces are constructed test records or a fixture.
